The Oaks Mall.fact: In February 2025, U.S. Bank filed a foreclosure complaint, claiming that the Oaks Mall LLC defaulted on more than $78 million of their $118.3 million loan that they borrowed from German American Capital Corp in September 2012. In March 2025, Spinoso Real Estate Group DLS, LLC was chosen by a magistrate to take control of the mall, including having the authority to terminate any current employees.
